title: Reinforcement learning with an evolutionary prior guides multi-site enzyme optimization
summary: AlphaVariant couples a generative evolutionary prior with iteratively updated low-N fitness models in a reinforcement-learning search of combinatorial protein sequence spaces. In Savinase design rounds it produced activity-improved variants with up to 17 mutated sites, the best reaching 7.1-fold wild-type activity in two cycles, and multi-objective variants outperformed the commercial protease Uno 100 L in biochemical and detergent washing tests. A bioRxiv preprint known from its abstract only; hit rates beyond 75.4% were not fully read.
